title: Spotify Analytics
summary: End-to-end analytics pipeline surfacing personal listening patterns and preference shifts.

blocks.content:
## Overview

Built an end-to-end analytics pipeline to process long-term personal Spotify data, applying temporal and behavioral analysis to surface listening patterns and preference shifts not captured by native platform insights.

## What I Built

Using the Spotify Web API and Python, I pulled years of streaming history and built a Streamlit dashboard that surfaces stats the platform doesn't show you — top genres by era, listening time distribution across the day/week, how my music taste shifted season to season, and artist loyalty over time.

## Stack

Python · Pandas · Spotipy · Streamlit · Plotly

title: BallWatch
summary: Multi-persona basketball analytics platform with role-specific insights for coaches, GMs, and analysts.

blocks.content:
## Overview

BallWatch is a multi-persona basketball analytics platform that surfaces role-specific insights for coaches, general managers, and analysts — built on a normalized MySQL database of real NBA season data.

## What I Built

Designed a schema to store player stats, team performance, and game logs, then built a Flask API layer with persona-aware query routing. A Streamlit front end lets each user type — coach, GM, scout — see exactly the data relevant to their decisions without wading through noise.

## Stack

Flask · MySQL · SQLAlchemy · Streamlit · Python

title: Hooper
summary: Full-stack basketball chatbot with real-time streaming and a local LLM backend.

blocks.content:
## Overview

Hooper is a full-stack basketball chatbot that answers natural language questions about NBA players, teams, and history — powered by a local LLM via Ollama with real-time response streaming.

## What I Built

Built an Express.js backend that pipes Ollama's streaming output directly to the client via server-sent events, keeping latency low and the interface feeling responsive. The React front end handles stream parsing and renders markdown responses incrementally as they arrive.

## Stack

Express.js · React · Ollama · Server-Sent Events · Node.js
